description: This file defines the 'Server' class responsible for handling HTTP requests, serving pages, and managing responses in the documentation system. It includes methods for serving themes, generating responses, and handling the request lifecycle.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A class responsible for handling HTTP requests, serving pages, and managing responses within the documentation system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the Server object with a Daux instance and sets up the request and base URL.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Static method to initialize configuration, generate the documentation tree, and serve the initial page.

methods.name: getTemporaryFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with the specified suffix for mime type detection.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates an HTTP response object based on the type of page content.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and adjusts the configuration for the current request.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request and returns the corresponding page object.

methods.name: serveTheme
methods.description: Serves a theme file if it exists, or throws a NotFoundException.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Retrieves the page object based on the request path, generating it through the configured generator.
